curated.tagline: Push-to-talk voice computer-use agent for Omarchy, decided by Jev
curated.description: Jev-powered voice computer-use agent for Omarchy on Hyprland and Asahi. Push-to-talk feeds whisper.cpp, Jev returns a typed decision, and the result drives a guarded hyprctl launch with a breathing dim overlay.
highlights: Push-to-talk voice control of the desktop
Typed decision model rather than free-text prompting
Guarded launch path — actions are gated, not freeform
Breathing dim overlay for visible agent state
curated.architecture: Push-to-talk → whisper.cpp transcription → Jev typed decision → guarded hyprctl launch → dim overlay
